observation_indicators.observable_fil: Tamang paraan; lahat ng bahagi ng magkabilang kamay; kumpletong oras at pagpapatuyo; walang muling kontaminasyon.
observation_indicators.observable_en: Appropriate method; all surfaces of both hands; complete timing and drying; no recontamination.
observation_indicators.not_yet_fil: Handrub ang ginagamit sa may dumi, iniiwan ang mahahalagang bahagi o pinupunasan ang basang handrub.
observation_indicators.not_yet_en: Uses handrub on visibly dirty hands, misses essential surfaces or wipes off wet handrub.

levels.kaya_na_fil: Kumpleto ang dalawang demonstration at lahat ng hakbang sa checklist nang walang paalala.
levels.kaya_na_en: Completes both demonstrations and every checklist step without prompting.
levels.kailangan_practice_fil: Tama ang paraan pero may nakaligtaang bahagi o hakbang; naitatama sa muling demonstration.
levels.kailangan_practice_en: Chooses the correct method but misses a surface or step; corrects it in a repeat demonstration.
levels.hindi_pa_fil: Handrub ang ginagamit sa may dumi, iniiwan ang mahahalagang bahagi o pinupunasan ang basang handrub.
levels.hindi_pa_en: Uses handrub on visibly dirty hands, misses essential surfaces or wipes off wet handrub.
